players.bio: Aden Flint is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL League Two club Rochdale. Flint was previously with Swindon Town and before that Alfreton Town and has represented England C national football team.

Babajide Ezekiel Adeeko (born 3 April 2003) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Rochdale AFC. In 2022, Adeeko was called up to the Republic of Ireland under-19 team for their Under-19 Championship qualifiers. He made one appearance for the team in their 4–0 win against Armenia.
Bryant Akono Bilongo (born 15 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender.
Casey Anthony Pettit is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League Two club Rochdale A.F.C..
Charlie Kian Tasker is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Rochdale, on loan from the academy of Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion.
Cian Jude Hayes is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League Two club Rochdale. Born in England, he is a youth international for Ireland.

Dajaune Anthony Brown (born 16 October 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Rochdale, on loan from EFL Championship club Derby County. Brown after coming through the academy, signed his first professional contract in July 2023, a month later Brown would make his first team debut for Derby.
Daniel Thomas Moss is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender (right-back) for EFL League Two club Rochdale A.F.C..

Devante Darrius Rodney (born 19 May 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Rochdale. Rodney began in the youth team of Manchester City at the age of nine, he remained in Manchester for six years before joining the ranks of Sheffield Wednesday.
Edward Albert Francis (born 11 September 1999) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Rochdale.

Emmanuel Dieseruvwe (born 20 February 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Rochdale A.F.C.. Standing at an imposing 6 ft 5 in (1.95 m), he is a powerful target man known for his aerial threat and physical presence in the final third.
Ethan Reid Ebanks-Landell (born 16 December 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Rochdale.

Glenn Bell Dollar Middleton is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League Two club Rochdale. He made 22 appearances for the Scotland under-21 team. Early life Born in Glasgow, Middleton was a keen supporter of Rangers as a child. His family relocated to the Northampton area in 2006, and he spent some time developing in the youth teams at Northampton Town.
Harvey James Gilmour is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Rochdale.

Ian Henderson (born 24 January 1985) is an English professional footballer who currently plays for Rochdale. Henderson has played most of his career as a forward, but he has also been used in various midfield roles, he can operate on both sides of the pitch as a winger, and has captained his club on numerous occasions.

Ian Watson is an English professional football coach who serves as the Head Coach of EFL League Two club Rochdale AFC. Hailing from the North East of England, the 40-year-old built a strong reputation as a progressive, possession-based tactician before taking his first major number-one managerial role.
Jamie Charles Stuart Paterson is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Rochdale.
Jonathan Gary Smith (born 28 July 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League Two club Rochdale.
Kaiden Wilson is a 21-year-old professional football defender who plays for Chelsea but is currently out on a season-long loan at Rochdale AFC for the 2026/27 season.

Kane Taylor is a 21-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a versatile midfielder for League Two club Rochdale A.F.C., on loan from Premier League side Aston Villa F.C.. He is recognized as an energetic, "box-to-box" player capable of operating in central midfield, as a left-back, or even at centre-back.
Laurence Maguire is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Rochdale.

Luke James Hannant (born 4 November 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Rochdale. He spent his youth with Norwich City and Cambridge United, before embarking on a degree at Northumbria University. During his time as a student he played non-league football for Dereham Town and Team Northumbria.
Nils Arvid Eistrand Ramming is a footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Rochdale, on loan from the academy of Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion.
Olutobi Adebayo-Rowling (born 16 November 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two side Rochdale.

Ryan Henry East (born 7 August 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays for League Two club Rochdale. On 1 July 2016, East signed his first professional contract with Reading, extending it on 6 July 2017. On 12 March 2019, East signed a new contract, until the summer of 2021, and made his first team debut for Reading, becoming the 50th graduate from the club's academy.
Sam Beckwith is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender (typically at left-back or centre-back) for Rochdale A.F.C. in EFL League Two.
Dan Moss is a 25-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Rochdale.
Sam William John Waller is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Rochdale.

Zain Rio Silcott-Duberry (born 9 July 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Rochdale. Career Born in Hackney, Silcott-Duberry started his career at Norwich City, before joining Chelsea in 2017. He signed his first professional contract in August 2022. On 17 January 2025, Silcott-Duberry joined Premier League club Bournemouth.
